groups.decision_problem: After picking up the task-relevant object, deciding to go to the sinkbasin to clean it before delivery, then determining whether the destination must be opened before moving the cleaned object into or onto it.
groups.shared_basis: Both executions acquire the target object and then face the same immediate choice between moving it onward and going to a cleaning station. P1:3 takes apple 2; P1:4-P1:5 goes to sinkbasin 1 and cleans it; P1:6-P1:7 goes to diningtable 1 and moves the apple. P4:7 takes kettle 1; P4:8-P4:9 goes to sinkbasin 1 and cleans it; P4:10-P4:12 goes to cabinet 1, opens it, and moves the kettle. Both complete a clean-then-place sequence successfully.
important_differences: P1 found apple 2 after opening closed fridge 1 at P1:2, while P4 searched multiple countertops and stoveburners (P4:1-P4:6, including a non-admissible go action at P4:5) before finding and taking kettle 1 at P4:7.

P1's destination, diningtable 1, was directly available for the move at P1:7, whereas P4's destination, cabinet 1, was closed and required the additional open action at P4:11 before the move at P4:12.

groups.decision_problem: When the requested dishsponge is not visible in the initial observations, deciding which cabinets, shelves, or fixtures to search next and when to extend the search beyond already-checked locations in order to obtain the dishsponge before cleaning and placing it.
groups.shared_basis: Both executions have a dishsponge-to-shelf objective and begin without a visible dishsponge. P2 checks sinkbasin 1, countertop 1, cabinets, and drawer 1 (P2:1-P2:7), then repeatedly returns to sinkbasin 1, countertop 1, cabinet 1, and drawer 1 (e.g., P2:8-P2:14, P2:21-P2:30) without observing a dishsponge; by P2:50 it has not acquired one. P3 follows a comparable initial search over sinkbasin 1 and shelves 1-3 (P3:1-P3:17), then extends to shelf 4 (P3:10), cart 1 (P3:18), and bathtubbasin 1 (P3:19), where dishsponge 3 is visible; it takes it at P3:20, cleans it at P3:22, and moves it to shelf 1 at P3:24.
important_differences: The rooms expose different search options: P2's initial room contains many closed cabinets and shelves 1-3, while P3's initial room contains bathtubbasin 1, cart 1, and shelves 1-4; P3 observed dishsponge 3 on bathtubbasin 1 at P3:19.

P2 revisited sinkbasin 1, countertop 1, cabinet 1, and drawer 1 several times and left many later-numbered cabinets and shelves unvisited as of P2:50, whereas P3, after early repeats, moved on to shelf 4, cart 1, and bathtubbasin 1 and then completed the clean-and-place sequence.
P3 acquired a dishsponge and succeeded at P3:20-P3:24, while P2 ended at the step limit at P2:50 without having observed or picked up a dishsponge.
